utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Case number IT-95-9-T, the Prosecutor versus Blagoje Simic, Miroslav Tadic, and Simo Zaric.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. Cross-examination is continuing with Mr. Pisarevic, for ten minutes, and then Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: Cross-examined by Mr. Pisarevic: [Continued]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Fitozovic.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yesterday we left off when we were discussing whether you are expert enough to discuss certain things. I have a following question for you: You returned to Bosanski Samac at around 1300 hours from the village of Prud?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you tell us at what time, approximately, you returned?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can. At around 9.30.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Did you return on your own, or did someone else come with you?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I returned with a driver. That was in our second attempt. I managed to cross.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was that driver, other driver, Mr. Namik Suljic?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I would need assistance from the Trial Chamber. It is my intention to show certain documents to the witness. This is the document entitled "The organisational structure of the defence of the town." The document has been disclosed to the Prosecution. We do have the translation of this document. However, in the course of the proceedings, in various stages of the proceedings, some attachments to this document have been used and have been shown to various witnesses and were assigned certain numbers by the Registry. However, since this document contains 17 pages, I'm not quite sure how to tender this document, whether in its entirety, all the 17 pages, or to continue looking at it in parts, each attachment in itself.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: It very much depends on how you want to present your Defence case, whether you want to have it as a whole document or there are just certain pages you want to use, in which case then we simply consider the pages.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I'm really sorry. I didn't get the interpretation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Oh, I see. Okay. I'll repeat what I was saying. I said that the presentation of the document depends entirely on how you intend to use it in your defence. If you want to use it as an entire document, which means -- the story is continuous, or whether it is separate aspects of the document you want to use, in which case then you can only present those pages you need if they have already been referred to, in which case they already have a number, then we simply get it from the Registry. If there are new pages you need, we simply introduce them for the first time. It's entirely up to you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. I then wish to tender this document in its entirety. I want to have it admitted in its entirety, the 17-page-long document, entitled "The organisational structure and establishment for the units of the defence of the town." And now I would like this document to be distributed to the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Is it dated?

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, it is not dated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: I see. All right. Yes, you can distribute it, and let's see. Mr. Weiner?

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: I'm just waiting for a copy of the document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Oh, to look at it.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Before I even ask the Prosecution, I just want to ask Mr. Pisarevic: Is it the position of your Defence case that this document was produced in its entirety as it is, page 18, or have you just collected the various pieces and put them together?

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, this is a single document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Your Honours, with permission of the Bench, if I may be able to approach Mr. Weiner --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: -- and maybe show him something. I think it could possibly speed up --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Okay, yes. Maybe you can do that, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Weiner. You've got the document?

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: I have now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Okay. I see. So you just got this whole one right now, during the proceedings? I thought you had been given the document before.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Apparently Mr. Zecevic filed this sometime back in August.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: As an entire document, or just pieces of it? As an entire document?

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: I have no idea. I assume as an entire document. And apparently the next document they're going to file was translated together, so there's a little bit of a confusion with the number. I think what we have got to do is show them to the witness. It's really the witness who can tell if it's an entire document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: It will very much depend on what questions will be discussed with the witness and thereafter then you can indicate your position.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Correct. And some of the documents within the first package have already been discussed with the witness. It concerns the hunters' section.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: But others have not been discussed. Some two of the documents in the first package the witness indicated were a forgery or some sort of manufactured -- so it's up to the witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. Let's see how the Defence goes about it. Yes, Mr. Pisarevic. The question of admissibility will be done after -- will be discussed after you've gone through the document with the witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honours. Could we perhaps be given the ID for this document?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honours. This document will be D25/4 for the English translation and D25/4 ter ID for the B/C/S version. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: I do apologise, Your Honours. Maybe I misunderstood your directions from yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Pantelic.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: Since the case is severed for Mr. Milan Simic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: Do we still have this "/43" because now we are three defendants? Or we shall leave it --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. To lessen confusion it's better to leave the numbering as they are.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: Okay. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would now like the document to be placed on the ELMO and then I would like to talk about it for a while with Mr. Fitozovic. Could the English translation please be put on the ELMO, and you can let the gentleman keep the Serbian version.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, before you, you have a document. You already spoke about the attachments thereto, and you stated that you authored the attachments. I would now like you to read the attachment number 1?

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: I would object at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Weiner.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: I'd object to the statement that he has already indicated that he authored the attachments. He has not indicated that he authored all of the attachments. Selected attachments he has authored. He indicated that some were fraudulent or forged or however you want to categorise it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, because the question is talking about all attachments, and if you look at the document, right from page 1, it's attachment number 1, up to the end, and some of the pages -- yes, up to attachment 9.4 on page 18. So I think Mr. Weiner's objection is sustained. You had better go through maybe each attachment to see which ones the witness had agreed that he had authored them.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Including the cover page too.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, starting from page 1, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Also, Mr. Pisarevic, I really think, for the sake of justice and the accused persons, that we should have them being able to read the B/C/S version on the ELMO, because at the moment all we have is the English version, and I don't think that is quite correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I agree with you, Your Honour. Could we then have the English - I'm sorry - Serbian version on the ELMO, the B/C/S version.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, would you be so kind to read the first page that you have before you.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I will do so. "SDA, Party of Democratic Action, Bosanski Samac."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you now please read what is written in the top right-hand corner.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I will "strictly confidential, attachment number 1, copy number 2."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Would you now be so kind as to read the title, which is in the middle of the page.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Organisational and establishment structure of the unit for the defence of the town."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Is this the document, or rather, did you author this page?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did not author the first page, because obviously there's something wrong with the number 2 here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please now turn to page 2. This page has already been shown to you?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is the municipal Crisis Staff D2/4. That's its number. You said that you did not make this document but that the people listed here in this document were mostly the members of the SDA Crisis Staff?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I said that there was no municipal Crisis Staff. I said that there was only the SDA Crisis Staff.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Excuse me, Mr. Pisarevic. Just for the sake of clarity, can we just agree on the page numbering here, just so that we're all following exactly what is progressing with your cross-examination? Because we have -- I'm looking right now at the English version. We have a page 1 at the bottom of the page, and then the next page number is 5, then 6, then 7, and so on. Now, that might well be a computer page numbering or a fax page numbering, but I think we have to be exactly sure what we're talking about. Because also at the top of the page, the fax page numbering, we begin on page 2 and then we go to page 6, 7, and so on. So I think we want to be exactly clear that we're all looking at the same page at the same time.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Your Honours, if I may explain.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, I think we need an explanation.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: I already explained that to my colleague, Mr. Weiner. That was probably what was confusing him. We gave -- actually, Mr. Zecevic, as Defence counsel of Mr. Simic, gave two documents together of translation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: So when we received the translation, that was a joint translation of two documents, and this explains. First page of this document, then three pages of another document, and then it continues with page 4, 5, 6. So now we separated these two documents as soon as we noticed that, and this is the explanation why the numbers of translations are not going in lines.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: But I can assure the Court that after this document, Mr. Pisarevic will tender the other document of three pages --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Which is a different document from this one.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Yes, this is actually a different document but they were given on translation together. So the translators actually -- maybe it was Mr. Zecevic's fault. I cannot say that, but the two documents were translated together and this explains why this --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: So what the position is with D25/4 ID, it starts at the bottom, from page 1, and moves to page 5.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Actually, yes. -- other document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: And then there follows consecutively to page 18.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: It is very obvious.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, let's make sure that we're all looking at the same page. The best thing would be to look at the upper right-hand corner, where it says "attachment number --" and then it will say 2, 3, 4, and so on and so forth.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. You can proceed that way.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are all the persons listed on this document Muslim?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, on this document they are all Muslim.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you now take a look at the attachment number 3, that's page 3.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You've already seen this document as well?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I will just ask you the following, then --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Before, Mr. Pisarevic, let's stick to one line of identifying the pages. Simply say attachment number 3. Don't say page 3, because the page at the bottom, there's no page 3. So simply stick to attachment number, that's all. All right? Then we don't get confused that way.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So this is attachment number 3. We have already talked about this.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You said that there was no municipal military staff. Can you tell me if there was a town board of SDA of Bosanski Samac?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you then tell me if the persons on this list are all Muslims?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Attachment 4.1, you have not seen this document before. It has not been shown to you before, that is to say.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I have not seen it before.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please tell me whether you are the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I wouldn't be able to say that right away. This is the third day of cross-examination, and I feel somewhat tired physically. In order for my testimony to be relevant, I don't think I am able to answer this question right now. I would need some time to concentrate.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, I'm just wondering - and this is a general question - with respect to the lists that you've seen and some of which -- or maybe all of which are contained in this document, I'm just wondering how you drew the lists you wrote together. Did you know, for example, that certain people should be on the hunters' lists because they were hunters, certain persons should be on the communications list, certain on the supply list, and certain persons because perhaps you knew they had military training and should be on the anti-sabotage list? I'm just wondering how you drew up the lists that you can recall that in fact you drew up.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, in front of me I have a document that consists of 17 or 18 pages, and this is the first time that I see the entire document. When I came up to attachment 3, I noticed that there were certain things that are truthful, that correspond to the truth, but certain other documents were not true. Maybe the signature of the attachment 4 made sense. I'm going to answer your question. The unit that I created was based exclusively on the survey that I conducted amongst the citizens of Bosanski Samac. So there was a questionnaire that was made like a table: Under number 1 -- so there were ordinal numbers, and the first number contained information of the person's first, last name, and father's name, then there was the unique identification number of every citizen, then the next row contained the military specialty. It was called the Ves number, but it was really the military specialty that was done by that person while serving the military service in the JNA, so every person filling out this questionnaire would enter what kind of military specialty or course they had during their JNA service. In the fifth column, the signature of that citizen was located, and these signatures were all done voluntarily. Your Honour, if the Defence managed to obtain these documents while they were looting my apartment, they could have also shown this Tribunal the other pieces of evidence, and also many other documents that were found in my briefcase, but those other documents might not suit the Defence. This document looks like one single document, but while I looked at the first four pages, I noticed that not everything is quite the way it should be. I was also trained in the military, and I was trained to make certain copies or forge certain things. It's a well-known fact how to make those things. It's a kind of a tactic, really. It's kind of an accepted tactic. So at this moment, considering the fact that I was cross-examined the day before yesterday, yesterday, and even today, and then two and a half days before that I was answering the questions of the Prosecutor, at this very moment I really would not like to discuss this document. I'm not trying to avoid to say my opinion about this document and to help both the Prosecution and the Trial Chamber and, of course, as well, the Defence. Because of my physical weakness, I do not want to say something that is not true, which, if I did do so, this might have repercussions for the defendants, and I would not like to say anything that is not true. I would like to ask you to bear in mind what I just said.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Fitozovic. Some of your explanations are acceptable, but I just want to correct you when you said that some of the documents found in your apartment when it was looted by the Defence. There is no evidence to that effect, and I do hope that the Defence don't take it the way the witness put it. There is no such evidence before the Trial Chamber. Coming to your explanation as to whether or not you can remember whether or not you authored some of the documents, you can answer the best way you can. If you notice that the particular document appears to contain information you might have authored but it looks different today, as presented to you, then you say so.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Just one other thing, Mr. Fitozovic. In your --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Sorry. Mr. Fitozovic, you mentioned in response to my question as to how you formulated the lists that you yourself have mentioned before, that you drafted. And you've just stated that you did a survey to the persons, citizens in Bosanski Samac. I just would like to know whether this survey was sent to persons of all ethnic groups in Bosanski Samac.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] While I testified, Your Honour, two days ago, I said that the survey was public and that it was conducted on the streets, in a public place, in front of the hotel in Bosanski Samac. So every citizen could come up and sign their name and register. Whoever didn't want to do so could go to the other side of the street or just pass by the table without stopping. So nobody was forced to do it. I also said in my testimony that many names that are on the lists, that the very people that signed their voluntary -- that they were voluntarily joining the unit had no time to find out what kind of a duty they would have within the Territorial Defence. In this document that is in front of me, the first page does not correspond to what it's supposed to be like, and that that is starting from the very top of the page, because it says "SDA party," but I think that in the future, my future testimony here, I will be able to say more about the relationship between the SDA and this unit, that is to say, that there was no relationship between the SDA party and the formation of this unit.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, these documents are very important, and we have to go through them. Therefore, I would like to ask you, if at all possible, to go through them now. You do not have to say a lot about these documents. You should just say whether you are the author of a particular document or not, or you should just say "I don't know." So these are the three options that you have. And I do understand that you are tired. We all are, and this is not easy on any of us. But if you could please try a little bit harder to go through these documents. I do not want you to feel that this testimony is some kind of a torture for you, but I do feel that you should try a little bit harder so that we can finish these things up.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this kind of a pace feels exactly like what you just said.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So we reached attachment 4.1.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Pisarevic, as I said, I cannot follow this in such a way. This is a collection of --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Mr. Weiner.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] -- true documents and those that are not.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Your Honour, I have a suggestion. Since the witness is seeing a lot of these documents for the first time, some possibly for the first time in years, maybe a ten minute recess. I don't have to talk to him. Let him go to the witness room, go through these 15 or so documents, as opposed to having him look at each one of these for the first time and spend five minutes per document. Maybe we could just do this to save some time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. I think that in fact Judge Lindholm was making a similar suggestion, that we give him time.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have another suggestion. Since I am planning to tender another document into evidence. It only has three pages. While the witness is looking at the first document he might also take a look at the second document. This is a document that is called -- I'm going to find the title right away.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Is this the organisation and method of receiving, transmitting, and conveying orders for the mobilisation? Is that that one?

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, that's exactly the document I was talking about.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: That was just given to me. That's fine. Give him all the documents so we can move on and get through this.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Pisarevic, this is another problem -- counsel, I hope you can hear me. This is another problem we've been discussing throughout this case on documents. Why weren't these documents given to the Prosecution before today? I know that some pages, they have been discussed, but those that haven't been discussed in this case so far. Mr. Pisarevic?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Your Honours, I'm the one who is called to respond to this question. First of all, these documents -- this document, both these documents, were disclosed to the Prosecutor months ago. Then, the day before yesterday, I gave this document to the Prosecution, to Mr. -- I don't remember what was his last name, but who was case manager of the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: And so I believe we did everything. I don't feel that we did anything to ambush the Prosecution or something. So there are at least two times that we gave this document to the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: I see. Okay. All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Your Honour, I'm not objecting. They can show the documents. I don't know what the mix-up was, but I think the easiest thing is to send the witness out.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: All right. So --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: We'll give the witness -- we will adjourn for 20 minutes so that the witness can go through the documents and then perhaps he'll be able to give his answers when we come back. We shall resume the proceedings at 1520. And this means we will recap. We may not have the normal breaks that we have because of the 15-minute break that we are going to have now. The Court will rise for 20 minutes. We shall resume the proceedings at 1520

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Pisarevic. You can continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, are you ready to proceed?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I am.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now we've come to attachment 4.1.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Could we please go from the beginning?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: From the beginning?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I believe that we have already gone through these?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. Now that the witness has had time to look at these, can we just start again, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, of course. Could you just put the English translation, page 1, on the ELMO. No. In fact, the Serb version.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. I thought we had an extra copy besides the one the witness has to look at.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You have had the opportunity to look at these documents during the break?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please be so kind as to read what is written in the top left-hand corner. We have already gone through this. The attachment 1, is this an attachment that you authored?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did not author page 1, and it of course does not correspond to the original.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Excuse me. Just a question of clarification here. Mr. Fitozovic, if you did not author page 1, how do you know that it did not correspond to the original?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, page 1 in the original was titled "The municipal staff of the Territorial Defence of Bosanski Samac," not "Party of Democratic Action." I would like to ask if they have the original, not the photocopy of the document but the original. If I had that, I would be able to be even more specific.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, you have already told us that you did not author this document; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm sorry. Are you -- when you say "a document," are you referring to just one page or its entirety?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The entirety. But we decided to go page by page. The title page is marked as attachment 1. You can see here where it says "attachment 1."

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I see, attachment 1, and I see that it says here "copy 2."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I asked you a question about the attachment 2, and there is also the -- it says here "copy 2." You say that you did not author this document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did not author page 1 of this document.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can we go on to attachment 2.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Mr. Pisarevic, for the sake of clarity, I just want for the record to get this straight. The witness, I think quite correctly, is asking you, when you say this is page 18, line 25, Mr. Fitozovic says: "Are you -- when you say "a document," are referring just to one page or its entirety?" Mr. Pisarevic, your answer is: "The entirety." But then you say: "But we decided to go page by page." I think from the point of view of the record and for the sake of the witness, we need, for the record, for you to say that we are going to ask the witness, page by page, whether he can attest that this was a document that he knows and he authored, because your response there, by saying "the entirety," on line 2 of page 19, is quite oblique because of what follows. I think we need to have this exactly clear.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, you have before you the entire document that contains 17 pages. The pages are numbered in the following way: The title of the document is "The organisational and establishment structure of the unit of the defence of the town." The pages are numbered in such a way that the front page, page 1 of the document, is designated as attachment 1.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Copy 2.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you just take it slowly.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Copy 2.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I will ask you about the document in its entirety by going through the document page by page, quoting the attachments as they are designated, asking you whether the document in its entirety was made by you or whether just some parts of the document were made by you. Can we do it like that?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Mr. Pisarevic, that is wrong, because you are confusing both the entire document and page by page. Can we do it page by page, okay? Let's start with attachment 1. You ask your questions of the witness. Because I don't want confusion, because we also know that some of the pages, some of the documents in this page, have already been discussed. So attachment 1. Go ahead with your question.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Attachment 1 is a document entitled "Organisational and establishment structure of the units for the Defence of the town," made by the SDA, Party for Democratic Action, in Bosanski Samac. Do you recognise this document as a document that you yourself made or not?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Attachment 1, copy 2, entitled "The organisational and establishment structure for the unit of the defence of the town," authored by the Party of Democratic Action, well, I do not recognise it as a document that I made. In other words, this is a forgery.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Let us go on to the second sheet of paper, attachment 2, copy 2. Have you found it? This is the document that you have already seen, and you have said that there was no such thing as the municipal Crisis Staff; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So my question is: Are the people listed in this document members of the town board of the SDA?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: My answer is no.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Before that, you asked me if they were Muslims. I said that they were, and I said that the municipal Crisis Staff did not exist.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could we now go on to attachment 3.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I have turned to this page.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is a document that you have also seen?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Can you please tell me what copy is that?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This document is entitled "The municipal military staff." There is no indication as to which copy it is, the copy number.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think it is important to get that into the record, that the copy number is not indicated.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes, yes. All right. You also said that there was no municipal military staff and you also said that there was no military staff of the town board of the SDA.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's what I said.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You also stated that all the persons listed in this document were of Muslim ethnicity; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's what I said.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are you the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I am not the author of this document.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we please now go on to attachment 4.1. Would you be so kind as to read the title of this document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Attachment 4.1, copy number -- blank."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read the title of this document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Engineer sabotage platoon."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read what is in the brackets.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Permanent formation," in brackets.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you set up this platoon in accordance with the survey that you conducted if this document was made by you?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did make this document. I did author this document. But the attachment -- I'm sorry. Let me finish. Attachment 1, attachment 2, attachment 3, contained something else. There was the attachment 1, 2, and 3, but the titles were completely different.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Please, sir.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I answered that attachment 4.1, no copy number, engineer sabotage platoon, permanent formation, in brackets, I answered that I did author this document.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The persons listed as members of the Engineer and Sabotage Platoon --

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Permanent formation.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Permanent formation, yes. Commanded by Ratif Atic, we have the sabotage section, were they assigned to this unit in accordance with the military specialty that they indicated in the survey?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The members of this squad listed here, or section listed here, are the people who had participated in the survey and who had agreed voluntarily to join the newly formed Territorial Defence. As for the second part of your question, I can say that because some of the military specialties were not present or represented, it does not mean that every person listed here had the appropriate military specialty for this kind of a unit.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I would merely like to ask you to keep your questions -- keep your answers short, to save time. Can you please tell me whether all the persons listed here are Muslims?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can we now go on to the attachment 4.2.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read the title of this document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Attachment 4.2, copy number -- blank." It is titled "Second anti-sabotage section."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you please look at it and -- in fact, you have already said that you were the author of this document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you tell us whether all the people were assigned to this section in accordance with their military specialty and whether all the members are Muslim.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In order to save time, my answer will be brief. The same answer as for the previous section, not to waste any time. So the military specialties do not correspond in every case, because there wasn't enough military specialties of a certain kind. All the persons listed here are of Muslim ethnicity.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you now please turn to --

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Weiner.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Before we turn to the next document, I just want to note for the record, in yesterday's -- in I think the testimony two days ago there's handwriting on the ter document, on the B/C/S document, that says "arrested." And I think we should just clarify again with the witness. He indicated he didn't write "arrested." That was written at some other time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, Counsel.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, you did not write the word "arrested" or these other words that are illegible here, but that is not your handwriting, in any case?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. In my testimony I said that I could not have put the word "arrested" here, and I think that it says "in prison" here. I couldn't have written that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could we now go on to our next page. It's attachment 4.3.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read the title of this document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Attachment 4.2, copy number -- blank." "Third engineering section," with its commander and nine members.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Mr. Weiner, before the witness continues, I think we have noted that it's also attachment 4.2.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Yes. I was just going to note that it looks like there's just a mistake from the translation section. The B/C/S version says "4.3," and our version here says -- the English version says "4.2."

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: So we should read it as attachment 4.3.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Fitozovic. You can go ahead with your answer.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The section commander is who?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Dervis Halilovic, Dedo. There's no reason to read it through, because we didn't do that in the previous pages.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I didn't mean for you to read. Are you the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I am the author of this document. At the time when this document was made, all the persons listed here did not know that they in fact belonged to this section.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, you have already stated that. That's why I didn't ask you that.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, but some things that you asked me before, you asked me again, and that is why I wanted to also answer in this manner.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are all these people Muslims?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, judging from their names, they are.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can you at least tell me whether Dervis Halilovic at least had engineering as his military specialty?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Could we now go to the next page. That's attachment 4.4?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Excuse me. Mr. Fitozovic, you say that that gentleman that you just mentioned, Mr. Halilovic, you didn't know that he had engineering as his military specialty. But if I recall, as per your citizens' survey of people on the street who came up to you and registered, they indicated what their background and specialties were. So if, as you say, you're the author of this document, and you put this gentleman as the commander, without knowing that he has any specialty in engineering, well, I would just like to hear your comment on this concern of mine with respect to your previous statements and what you just said now. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, these documents are made by a team that consists of at least 30 or 40 people in normal circumstances, and all those people should have officer knowledge. At the beginning of my testimony, I said that I created these lists alone. When I made this list, I could not have been at the same time the person who conducted the survey, who was placing people into different groups according to their specialty, and I could not coordinate all these activities by myself. And although I would like to, I really cannot remember for every person what military specialty they had, especially considering that this happened ten years ago. As I said, this kind of task is usually done by 30 to 40 people, and they organise a unit, so it takes 30 or 40 people to organise such a unit. When this was being created, I myself volunteered to create this unit, and I have said already to the Chamber that I was the author of these documents, and some of this was mentioned in my answers to the Prosecutor's questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please turn to the next page, attachment 4.4, and could you please read the title of this document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Attachment 4.4, copy number blank." "Engineering and sabotage Platoon."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please also read what is stated under number 1.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Special purposes section."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you also read the commander's name.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Ratif Atic.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So now, at the bottom of the page, could you read what is written under number 2.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Under number 2 it says -- actually, it's not number 2 as an ordinal number. It says "second intervention section." Intervention sections are numbers 1 and 2 of the permanent establishment.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Is Ratif Atic the commander, a member of the Engineering Corps?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I already explained to the Chamber this same matter.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Well, could you please repeat it. I don't remember.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are you the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I am.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are all the people on this document Muslims?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, all the people on this list are of Muslim ethnic background. But I'd like to explain the following: You can see the name of Ratif Atic here twice. You can see it also under number 2.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, we have noticed this.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, I'm not sure whether the Trial Chamber noticed it.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Counsel does not have his microphone turned on.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please turn to the next page. This is attachment 5.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Mr. Pisarevic, before you do that, I'd like to know from Mr. Fitozovic, just very briefly: What was the mandate of the anti-sabotage section as opposed to the sabotage section? What was the difference between these two groups, the sabotage platoon permanent formation and the anti-sabotage section? Just very briefly. I'd just like to have some understanding.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The sabotage section, in its war activities, would have as a goal to carry out sabotage activities and operations in the enemy rear, and the anti-sabotage section has as its goal to prevent such operations of the enemy.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please turn now to the next page, attachment 5. Could you please read the title of this unit.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Special Purposes Platoon."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And in brackets?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Police."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And the commander is Namik Suljic?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are you the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you carry out the corrections of this document at the very end, under number 4?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is this your handwriting?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Original.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are all the people on this list Muslims?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Excuse me, Mr. Pisarevic. In the B/C/S version, at least the copy I have in front of me, I don't have any handwriting, I don't think. Oh, I see. Sorry. I apologise. Number 4 at the bottom of the page, crossing out. Yes. I apologise.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you take a look?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I took a look. There's also an Albanian, an ethnic Albanian here, but he is probably of Islamic faith.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So one person is Albanian, but he's probably of Islamic faith?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, probably.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Let's now turn to the next page.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is attachment 6.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You've already seen this attachment?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And you said that this was the communications section?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And that you are the author of this document; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Let me also ask you the following: Are all the members of this communications section Muslims?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, all of them here are of Muslim ethnicity, but in this document here, that is to say, attachment 6, I have to say that the members of this section, because of the aggression, had no time to find out that they were members of this communications section.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Let's turn to the next page now, attachment 7.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read its title.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I will. It's called reconnaissance section.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And the commander is Aziz Hecimovic?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did he have some kind of a military specialty?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: He probably did. Yes, he did.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are all the men on this list Muslims?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just a second. Yes. There's one ethnic Albanian here, under number 4, and under number 8 it says "in Germany." I assume that this person did not go to Germany on a reconnaissance mission.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read what attachment this is?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's attachment 7, copy 2.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Are you the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please turn to the next page, attachment 8. You have seen it before. Copy number?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's blank.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is this the hunters' section?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Commander Hasan Jasarevic?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You said that you authored this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please tell me if all the members of this section are Muslims?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: All members of this section are of Muslim ethnicity, and all the members of this section were registered with the competent municipal authority as hunters; that is to say, they had documentation stating that they were hunters and they had hunting weapons.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you please turn to the next page.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I will.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read what it says on the very beginning.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Attachment 9.1, copy 2."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. What is the name of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Logistics base."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are you the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I'm the author of this document.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please confirm that all the people on this list are of Muslim ethnicity?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, they all are of Muslim ethnicity. There is also one or two Albanians here, actually.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please turn to the next page. Could you please read what is written in the upper right-hand corner.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Attachment 9.2, copy 2." "Supplies section."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: We have already talked about it. You said this was your document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are you its author?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please tell me whether all the persons listed in this document are of Muslim ethnicity?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you please turn to the next page. Could you please read what attachment number this is?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Attachment 9, copy 2.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'm not sure you read the attachment number right. The attachment number is --?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Attachment 9.3, copy 2.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Please. Please go on.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Third technical maintenance section.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are you the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, of course.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Under number 4, is there a name that was crossed out? Is there another name added right next to it? And if it is, is this your handwriting?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are all the persons on this document of Muslim ethnicity?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, all the persons in this document, on this list, are of Muslim ethnicity.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Could you please turn to the next page.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, of course.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could the counsel and witness please make pauses between questions and answer.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read what is written in the upper right-hand side corner.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Attachment 9.4. We have already talked about this.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Medical section?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Can you please pause between question and answer. The interpreters are overworked.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I will try my best.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You have already seen this document; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I have already seen it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You said that you were the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please confirm that all the persons listed on this document of are Muslim ethnicity?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I can confirm that they're all Muslims. I can also say that this medical section is comprised of those that had medical training.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The commander of this section, Emir Pasovic?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What is his occupation?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: He completed the school of reserve officers. He completed the medical section of that school. His rank was lieutenant and his occupation was dentist.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: There is a remark that I am hearing. You did not read that this was attachment -- what attachment this was.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Attachment 9.4, copy 2.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. I would now like you to take a look at the last attachment that was part of this document. This is a diagram that is called "Organisational and formational structure of the units for the defence of the town."

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Mr. Pisarevic, excuse me. I don't believe we have that here on the Bench. We just have the document you've gone through. We don't seem to have the other one that you're referring to now.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't have it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: There are no copies for the Bench.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I really don't know. I know that we did submit this for translation. I have it in my documents. It is a chart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Well, if the --

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] So if you allow us, Your Honours, perhaps we could put it on the ELMO and then the witness could state --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. As long as the witness has copies, the Registry has, and the Prosecution have, we can go ahead. Yes, Mr. Weiner.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: I just want to see if that's -- if we have copies. We do.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The registrar does not have a copy of this document. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It's not a problem. We will withdraw this document.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: We can have it on the ELMO perhaps. Then counsel can see whether that's the document he wants to discuss.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, I would like to ask you to take a look at this document which is now in front of you. It is a chart entitled "The organisational and establishment structure of the unit for the defence of the town," is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Your Honours, I really did not expect that I would be given documents just like that, without any preparation, without having had the opportunity to at least hold them in my hand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: I thought this was one of the documents after -- when we had this break. I thought this was one of the documents the witness was given to look at, Mr. Pisarevic. That's why I --

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I had it as part of my document and I thought that the other copies of the document also contained this document. I am also quite amazed. I don't know why this document was not attached to the other documents that were submitted to you, Your Honours, and to the Prosecution, and I also believe that in the course of the break, the witness has had the opportunity to look at it. But at any rate, this is not a problem. I can withdraw this document so that the witness does not have to say anything about it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: All right, then.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And we will solve this in some other way.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: I'd have no problem with another attorney putting that document in if we have a break at about 5.00, letting the witness see it at a short break, if they feel it's important to their case.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. That's up to the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. This is the second document that is entitled "The organisation and method of receiving, transmitting, and conveying orders for the mobilisation." This document was disclosed to the Prosecution a long time ago. We do have the translation of this document, and I believe that the witness has also been shown this document in the course of the break. And I would now like copies to be distributed to the Trial Chamber and to the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Counsel. You can go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would like the registrar to assign an ID number for this document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. Can we have a number for it, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honours. It is D26/4 ter ID for the B/C/S and D26/4 ID for the English version.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, during the break you had had the opportunity to look at this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I would now like to discuss this document. This document does not bear any markings, and it has three pages. Could you please read what it says in the left-hand corner.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "SDA, Party of Democratic Action, Bosanski Samac."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read the title of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Strictly confidential, attachment number blank, copy number blank. Organisation and method of receiving, transmitting, and conveying orders for mobilisation."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: All right. Have you ever seen page 1 of this document before?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I have never seen page 1 of this document before.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So you did not author page 1 of this document; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did not author page 1 the way it looks now. I did author page 1, which is headed by the municipal staff of the Territorial Defence of Bosanski Samac, and the title is more or less the same.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Could you now please turn to page 2.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'll do it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: There is a chart here. Could you please read its title.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Organisation and method of receiving, transmitting, and conveying orders for mobilisation."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you please read what is written in the first box here.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, of course. "Mobilisation -- responsible for mobilisation, president of SDA, unit commander."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Are you by any chance the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I am the author of this document, but not in this form. "Responsible for mobilisation" should read "the TO commander in Bosanski Samac." This has been put in later.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please turn to page 3.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please read the title.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: "Organisation and method of receiving, transmitting, and conveying orders for mobilisation."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you just read what is written in the first box.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. "Sulejman Tihic, Alija Fitozovic."

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please tell me whether you were the author of this document?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I am the author of a similar document, where --

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: My question, sir, was whether you were the author of this document.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I am not the author of this document. This document is a forgery. But the letters printed here are in my handwriting, but this word "Sulejman Tihic," that has been inserted. So this is a forgery. Everything here is correct. Alija Fitozovic, Ratif Atic, call-up service, all that is correct, but only the words "Tihic Sulejman" has been inserted. Mr. Pisarevic, let me tell you: Sulejman Tihic did not do his national service. He did not have his military specialty.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sir, we are familiar with all that. Could you please just answer my question.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I just don't know whether the Trial Chamber is aware of this fact.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you please tell me: The words that were written, handwritten here, Alamanvic, Fadil; Taletovic, Ibro; Atic, Dzevad; Vukovic, Ahmed?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you write this in your own handwriting?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I did. However, somebody else using the same typewriter that was taken from the offices of the SDA inserted the name of Sulejman Tihic, and the premises of the SDA had been looted.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Please, this document, was the mobilisation point the park?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think so. My answer is yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. All the persons listed here are of Muslim ethnicity; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Pisarevic. I can answer one of the questions that you asked me yesterday, that I still owe you the answer.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Well, I'm not particularly interested. I don't know what question you're referring to, but we're quite happy with the answers you've provided so far.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, thank you for saying that, because that indeed makes me happy, and I'm quite happy with it.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I've finished with the documents.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, is that the list of names that you couldn't recall yesterday that Mr. Pisarevic was asking you about?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. When he asked me whether any weapons, defensive hand grenades and shells had come in from Prud. I remembered the answer to that question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WILLIAMS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. I don't need to know the names myself. If Mr. Pisarevic does not want to recall them from you, that's fine. I was just interested to know whether that was the question that had been posed. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, that and the part pertaining to the names.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, do you recall the names of the persons that you claim were unloading weapons in Novo Naselje, or Sokolusa, or Mosa Pijade?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did not remember the names of the persons that unloaded the weapons in Mosa Pijade, but I remember the name of the driver, and the name of the person that unloaded the weapons in the Stadion neighbourhood, when we talked about Stevo Bozic, nicknamed Para.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Fitozovic, you said yesterday that you would remember the names of the persons who unloaded the weapons. You saw these people, yet as to what happened in Stadion, you heard about that, you didn't see it?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct, but now I remember the name.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You can tell the names to the Trial Chamber.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The driver who assisted in the unloading was Izet Atic, nicknamed Zec.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: He's an ethnic Muslim?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Probably, yes, but he unloaded the weapons for the purposes of the 4th Detachment, and he was a member of the 4th Detachment.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Please, please, please. In your testimony, in direct, you said that this happened in front of a house of a Serb. I asked you questions about that.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It was Stevo Bozic, nicknamed Para. That's what I said.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Please, sir, do you know -- no. I will not ask any further questions about that?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. I think we've had more than 10 minutes. I included the break and the fact that the witness needed to look at the documents. I thought that you have concluded your cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have only three more minutes. That's how much I require to finish all this.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You met with your wife on the 25th of August, 1992; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did she tell you who searched her apartment on that occasion?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did she say that the Bosanski Samac police did that?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The police and the formations that had come to Bosnia and Herzegovina.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Can we agree that they were the members of some paramilitary formations?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Members of the paramilitary formations and all my documents ended up with the defendant Simo Zaric.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sir, please. The only thing I'm asking you is who searched the house. Could you please just answer the question.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: My wife told me that the apartment was looted by the members of the military that had come in from Serbia, together with the members of the 4th Detachment and the police. After all, my wife gave a statement and had to report to the police, to Mr. Simo Zaric.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Who ordered your wife to report twice a day to the police?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Simo Zaric did.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Was your wife interrogated by Vlado Sarkanovic, Simo Bozic, and Milos Savic?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Simo Zaric.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: However, sir, in your statement that you gave to the Prosecutor in 1995, on the 13th, 14th, and 16th of February, 1995, in Orasje, you never once mentioned Simo Zaric as the person who searched or, as you say, looted your apartment, together with the others. Can you please say now --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Weiner.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
utterances.text: He's misquoting the testimony. This witness never said that Simo Zaric searched his apartment. He said that the police and paramilitaries searched the apartment, but Simo Zaric wound up with all the documents which were taken from his briefcase or taken from the apartment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, Mr. Pisarevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. PISAREVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Sir, you never once said that Simo Zaric ordered your wife to report to the police in -- to the police station in Bosanski Samac.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Pisarevic, am I to be considered guilty because I didn't say that in 1995? Is that an error on my part? I'm saying it now. That's why I'm here, to say it now.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes, but sir, my client tells me that he saw your wife in the SUP building on only one occasion, and that at that time she was angry with you for fleeing and for leaving her and the children alone in Bosanski Samac.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Pisarevic, that's really ironic, and it's an invasion of privacy, and that is what your client is saying.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Well, the accused is entitled to say -- to give his opinion about your testimony.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA FITOZOVIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Fortunately, I was able to flee, and that is why my wife, even today --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Weiner.

utterances.speaker: MR. WEINER
